report_name: Zoom Patches Zero-Click RCE Flaw in Conferencing App

vulnerabilities.name: Zoom Client Zero-Click RCE in Annotation Feature
vulnerabilities.description: A critical zero-click remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in the annotation feature of the Zoom client. A malicious participant could send specially crafted data during a screen share to execute arbitrary code on another participant's computer without user interaction.

indicators.name: Zoom Spawning Command Shell
indicators.pattern:
title: Zoom Spawning Command Shell
id: 9c1b9e3a-58d4-4f8e-8a6f-7c2d3e4f5a6b
status: experimental
description: Detects the Zoom process spawning a command shell (cmd.exe or powershell.exe), which could indicate post-exploitation activity following the compromise of a zero-click RCE vulnerability.
references:
  - https://www.securityweek.com/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-12
tags:
  - attack.t1059
  - attack.execution
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\Zoom.exe'
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the Zoom process spawning unexpected child processes like cmd.exe or powershell.exe, a potential indicator of post-exploitation activity.

indicators.name: Anomalous Outbound Network Connection from Zoom
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Outbound Network Connection from Zoom
id: 8d2c3e4f-5a6b-4c1b-9e3a-7f8e9a6f7b8c
status: experimental
description: Detects the Zoom process making network connections to destinations other than known Zoom servers. This requires baselining of legitimate Zoom domains and could indicate C2 traffic after exploitation.
references:
  - https://www.securityweek.com/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-12
tags:
  - attack.t1071
  - attack.command_and_control
level: medium
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\Zoom.exe'
    Initiated: true
  filter:
    DestinationHostname|endswith:
      - '.zoom.us'
  condition: selection and not filter
indicators.description: Detects the Zoom process making network connections to destinations other than known Zoom servers, which may indicate C2 communications.

indicators.name: Zoom Process Execution

status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of the Zoom client process. This is for tracking purposes and is not inherently malicious.
references:
  - https://www.securityweek.com/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-12
level: informational
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\Zoom.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of the Zoom.exe process, which is the context for potential exploitation of the RCE vulnerability.
